issues.title: The device contantly says the water tank is insufficient

items.snippet:
What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6011: The clean water in the station is insufficient, please add water, Base station clean water tank is empty, insufficient water error despite a filled tank, showed the clean water tank is empty, saying that the Clean water is insufficient, water in the clean water tank is insufficient?
1. Inspect the components of the clean water tank

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6020:Clean water tank or dirty water tank not connected, please check, Base Station Dirty Water Tank Not Installed?
1. Please put the dirty water tank back in the station correctly.
2. If the dirty water tank has been installed correctly and still reports an error, open the dirty water tank cover to check whether the float in the dirty wa

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6025:The dirty water tank is full or not in place, please check, The sewage tank of the base station is full or out of position?
1. Please check whether the dirty water tank of the station is installed in place.
2. Take out the dirty water tank and check whether it is full. If it is full, pour out the dirty water and clean the dirty water

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6031:Abnormal sewage pumping function, or the cleaning tray is full of water, or dirty water is not being pumped out, sent errors stating the pump is malfunctioning, or the water level of the station's cleaning tray is abnormal?
1. Check whether the door latch of the dirty water tank is fastened when it is installed on the station.
2. Che

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports an error 6012 or 6013:Sprinkler error/Base station clean water pump error/Water injection device is abnormal?
1. Please try unplugging and replugging the base station power cable. Note that after unplugging the power cable, wait 10 seconds before replugging it, and then restart the cleaning task. Observe whether the error continues.
2. If the error

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports an error 6022 or 6023:Station pump error/Base station dirty water pump error/Sewage pumping device is abnormal?
1. Please try unplugging and replugging the base station power cable. Note that after unplugging the power cable, wait 10 seconds before replugging it, and then restart the cleaning task. Observe whether the error continues.
2. If the err

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6032:Abnormal sewage pumping function or the cleaning tray is full or not in place?
1. Please check whether the cleaning tray is installed correctly.
2. Please check whether the buoy in the cleaning tray is installed correctly.
3. If the cleaning tray is in place and water accumulates in the cleaning tray:
a. Check whether the door latch

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6028: The base station may have a water leakage or abnormal sewage pumping function?
Check whether the station cleaning tray grille is clogged with sediment or foreign matter, and clean the cleaning tray.

Does the X10 Pro Omni have an onboard water tank?
Yes! The X10 Pro Omni is equipped with an onboard water tank that holds up to 80ml, ensuring that it can start its cleaning cycle without the immediate need for the Omni Station to wet the mopping pads. Additionally, the X10 Pro Omni's all-in-one Omni Station is equipped with a substantial 3-liter clean water tank.

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351's firmware upgrade fails and APP displays upgrade failure error code 2?
1. The device is at a station.
2. The device's battery level is ≥10%.
3. The device is not currently washing mops/collecting dust.

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a toast 65: Insufficient power, please charge to more than 30% before starting the task?
Please note that if the current battery level of the robot is less than 30%, the map creation task cannot be performed. Please wait until the battery level is greater than 30% before starting the map creation task.

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 5022:Low Discharge Temperature, Abnormal temperature?
1. If the battery temperature of the robot is too low during operation, in order to protect the robot and battery, please wait until the battery temperature rises before using it.
2. If the device often reports the warning: Low Discharge Temperature, please confirm whether the ambient

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a toast 78:Low battery, please charge and try again?
Please note that the current battery level of the robot is less than 30%, which makes it impossible to start the task. Please wait until the battery level is greater than 30% before starting the cleaning task.

I would like to know if I can purchase a replacement or additional base station for the Eufy X10 Pro Omni/T2351 robot vacuum.
Currently, the extra base station is not available, you can click "notify me" to get updated and order it when it is in stock. Below are links for you to order an extra base station and power adapter if needed. US: CA: UK： DE:
